identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Replace brittle fixed reload deadlines with configurable convergence

values.task_boundary: Change only Runtime-v3 service convergence policy and its focused proof; exclude providers, model execution, Observatory, Caddy, cloud, and Runtime v2.
deliverables: focused deterministic tests for slow success, expiry, invalid configuration, and recovery
strict Clippy, formatting, diff hygiene, and exact-head review evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Stop, unload, listener, and readiness limits are named validated configuration values with generous defaults.
AC-2: Configuration supports 5-10 minute model-backed startup without tiny operational deadlines.
AC-3: Reload remains continuously service-manager owned with no direct competing process.
AC-4: Deadline expiry identifies the exact stage and preserves a recoverable last-known service state.
AC-5: Focused tests prove slow success, true expiry, invalid bounds, rollback or recovery, and absence of fixed 15-second waits.
AC-6: General API request timeout semantics remain unchanged.
AC-7: No live Runtime restart occurs during implementation validation.
dependencies: Issue #656 / PR #658 atomic Runtime generation installation merged and ancestral to current main cea5219f6e74b34d930d0dc39b6a607bc6303acb
non_goals: Caddy, Observatory, cloud, or Runtime v2 changes
